## Architecture Overview

The `Planner` interface is defined in `thanos/pkg/compact/compact.go` (lines 841-845) with a single `Plan()` method. Three implementations exist in `thanos/pkg/compact/planner.go`: `tsdbBasedPlanner`, `largeTotalIndexSizeFilter`, and `verticalCompactionDownsampleFilter`. Mimir has its own separate `Planner` interface in `pkg/compactor/bucket_compactor.go` (lines 215-219) with a simpler signature. Adding `PlanWithFilter` requires updating both.
